summary_en: This Phase 2 single-arm trial tests atezolizumab combined with sacituzumab govitecan in triple negative breast cancer that remains after neoadjuvant chemotherapy, in the breast or lymph nodes, with circulating tumor DNA in the blood. Both drugs are given by intravenous (IV) infusion: atezolizumab on day 1 and sacituzumab govitecan on days 1 and 8 of each 21-day cycle, for 6 cycles (18 weeks total). The main outcome measure is not stated; the study is Phase 2.
summary_es: Este ensayo de Fase 2 de un solo grupo prueba atezolizumab combinado con sacituzumab govitecan en cáncer de mama triple negativo que permanece después de la quimioterapia neoadyuvante, en la mama o los ganglios linfáticos, con ADN tumoral circulante en la sangre. Ambos medicamentos se administran por infusión intravenosa (IV): atezolizumab el día 1 y sacituzumab govitecan los días 1 y 8 de cada ciclo de 21 días, durante 6 ciclos (18 semanas en total). La medida de resultado principal no está indicada; el estudio es de Fase 2.
who_for: Residual invasive breast cancer in the breast and/or lymph nodes after neoadjuvant chemotherapy.
HER2 negative primary tumor by local testing.
ER and PR negative primary tumor (under 10% of cells expressing hormone receptors).
Evidence of ctDNA in a blood sample collected after all neoadjuvant therapy.
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1, and age 18 or older.
not_for: Prior sacituzumab govitecan, irinotecan, or topoisomerase I antibody-drug conjugates for early stage disease.
Receipt of adjuvant chemotherapy after surgery.
Clinical or radiographic evidence of metastatic disease.
Active autoimmune disease, HIV, or hepatitis B or C.
